description: Remove up to 1000 fixed prices from a price list by key: recordId alone for a product without variants, recordId + variantKey for one variant of a product with variants; currency limits a key to that currency's row, without it every currency's row goes. Those products then fall back to the catalogue price minus the list's percentOff. Returns how many were removed; a key with no entry removes nothing.

keys.description: Up to 1000 product / variant keys whose fixed price to remove

currency.description: Omit to remove the row of every currency; an ISO 4217 code removes that currency's row only

variantKey.description: The variant's key - required for a product with variants (a list prices each variant separately, never the product as a whole); omit for a product without variants

name: remove_price_list_entries
title: Remove price list entries
